description: This Java source file defines the class RelinquishIdentityActivity, an Activity subclass in an Android app. It handles UI creation and provides a method to start a new document activity with specific intent flags to manage task and document behavior.

classes.name: RelinquishIdentityActivity
classes.description: An Activity that relinquishes task identity to allow other activities to generate new task entries, typically used in Android to control activity stack behavior.
